hooks.command:
echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "🛑 BLOCKED: Use the GitHub workflow instead.

✅ Correct workflow:
  1. Create feature branch: git checkout -b fix/your-feature
  2. Make changes and commit
  3. Push: git push origin fix/your-feature
  4. Create PR on GitHub for review
  5. Merge via GitHub UI (not locally)
  6. Vercel auto-deploys within 30s

Why: Deploying locally from non-main branches causes code mismatches. GitHub is your source of truth."}'
